elements.description: Content a policy blocked, redacted or rewrote: which policy, why, what changed – personal data masked – and Request review.

properties.name: action
properties.description: What the policy did: blocked the content, redacted parts of it or rewrote it – sets the icon, tone and wording

properties.name: layout
properties.description: Where it sits: "inline" in a thread, where the content would have been, or "banner" across the top of a view

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading – "Blocked by policy", "Redacted by policy" or "Rewritten by policy" by default

properties.name: policy
properties.description: The policy that acted, by the name people know it by, e.g. "Personal data"

properties.name: policyHref
properties.description: A link to the policy itself; the policy name becomes the link

properties.name: reason
properties.description: Why the policy acted, in a sentence

properties.name: original
properties.description: The content as it was, with personal data already masked by the app – text, or segments

properties.name: revised
properties.description: The content as it went out – text, or segments; leave it out when nothing went out

properties.name: revisedLabel
properties.description: The label over what went out – "Shown instead", "After redaction" or "Rewritten" by default

properties.name: open
properties.description: Whether the before / after is showing

properties.name: reviewable
properties.description: Offers Request review; set it to false where there is no one to review

properties.name: requested
properties.description: A review has been requested: the button shows "Review requested" and is off

properties.name: reviewLabel
properties.description: The label of the review button

properties.name: requestedLabel
properties.description: What the button says once a review is requested

properties.name: dismissible
properties.description: Shows a close button that fires tc-dismiss

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: "Show what changed" opened or closed the before / after. Cancelable. Detail: GuardrailOpenChange ({ open })

events.name: tc-review-request
events.description: Request review was pressed. Cancelable: unless prevented, the button turns into "Review requested". Detail: GuardrailReviewRequest ({ action, policy })

events.name: tc-dismiss
events.description: The close button of a dismissible notice was pressed; remove the notice in answer

props.name: title
props.description: The heading – "Blocked by policy", "Redacted by policy" or "Rewritten by policy" by default

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the before / after is showing. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether it shows at first when uncontrolled – closed by default

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: "Show what changed" opened or closed the before / after

props.name: onRequestReview
props.description: Request review was pressed; call event.preventDefault() to keep the button as it is (set `requested` yourself)

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close button; called when it's pressed – remove the notice in answer
